description: This file defines the interface 'DittoMongoClientBuilder' and its nested interfaces for building a MongoDB client with a fluent API, including configuration steps for connection string, host/port, database name, SSL, query time, connection pool, listeners, and read preferences.

classes.name: DittoMongoClientBuilder
classes.description: Main interface for building a DittoMongoClient with step-wise configuration.

classes.name: ConnectionCoordinatesStep
classes.description: Interface for setting connection coordinates: connection string or hostname and port.

classes.name: DatabaseNameStep
classes.description: Interface for setting the default database name.

classes.name: GeneralPropertiesStep
classes.description: Interface for setting general MongoDB client properties such as SSL, query time, connection pool, listeners, read preference, and building the client.

methods.name: connectionString
methods.description: Sets the connection string for MongoDB connection.

methods.name: hostnameAndPort
methods.description: Sets the hostname and port for MongoDB connection.

methods.name: defaultDatabaseName
methods.description: Sets the default database name for the client.

methods.name: enableSsl
methods.description: Enables or disables SSL for the connection.

methods.name: connectionPoolMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: connectionPoolMaxWaitQueueSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of waiters for connection pool.

methods.name: connectionPoolMaxWaitTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum wait time for a connection.

methods.name: enableJmxListener
methods.description: Enables or disables JMX connection pool listener.

methods.name: addConnectionPoolListener
methods.description: Adds a custom connection pool listener.

methods.name: setReadPreference
methods.description: Sets the read preference for the MongoDB client.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a new DittoMongoClient instance.
